name: Can I replace just the screen mesh or do I need a whole new frame?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace just the screen mesh or do I need a whole new frame?

acceptedAnswer.text: In many cases, you can replace just the screen mesh if the existing frame is still structurally sound and free from significant damage or warping. This approach is often more cost-effective. However, if the frame is bent, cracked, corroded, or doesn't roll smoothly on its track, replacing the entire screen door unit, including the frame, might be necessary for optimal performance and longevity. A professional assessment can determine the best course of action.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can often replace just the screen mesh if the frame is in good condition; otherwise, a new frame may be necessary.
